author: Josie Schrubbe
text: Bob did an amazing job on our sink repair! It was leaking and he came within 24-48 hrs to fix it. Great communication and very kind. Highly would recommend!

author: Bryan Bissonnette
text: Called them to replace an outdoor spigot.  Bob came by and was at my house for about 45 minutes.  Charged me almost double of what the the price of the spigot is at your local home improvement store for the part.  I appreciate the response but way over priced in my opinion for a simple job.

author: Ethan
text: Bob came to our home to do some non emergency repairs for us.  Even though it wasn't an emergency, he was here in a couple of days.  He had everything with him and immediately repaired our leaks.  I really appreciate that he took the time to explain to us what needed to be done and why.   I'll be calling Genrich Plumbing again for my plumbing needs.

author: Michael Miller
text:
I texted Bob early Friday and by early afternoon he replaced a faulty sensor on my hot water heater. Our hot water heater was back in service within 5 hours of my original text message.

If you need fast, effective and professional heating and plumbing service, who you gonna call?

author: Tim L
text: Our kitchen drain pipe was leaking extensively. I contacted Genrich Plumbing in the early morning. By late morning Bob had contacted me and scheduled an appointment that same day. Bob was very professional and efficient. He had the pipe replaced in a hour and he left the area clean. No messes. I was very impressed by Bob's work. I will be recommending Genrich Plumbing to others.
